target.title: improve: balance iOS typography roles
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where iOS onboarding/settings controls used the branded font family but overused semibold tokens, making secondary actions and inactive segmented options compete visually with primary actions.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds explicit iOS typography role guidance, then demotes non-prominent controls and secondary/manual actions to medium-weight tokens while preserving semibold for primary/prominent actions. The PR also includes two small build-unblock fixes discovered while preparing simulator visual proof: a SwiftFormat cleanup in `CommandCenterTab` and an explicit sendable SQLite handle wrapper for the existing synchronous cache proof-decision transaction.

## User Impact

Users should see calmer hierarchy in the iOS manual gateway setup flow and shared pro controls: primary actions remain visually dominant, while segmented choices and secondary actions read as supporting controls. Future iOS typography work has a clearer guardrail for token weight selection, not just font-family usage.

## Evidence

Side-by-side comparison using the reported screenshot and the live branch simulator screenshot:

![iOS manual fallback typography before and after](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/Solvely-Colin/48dc1499e6187b6c85dcb7cef68bc69c/raw/7e2d127d310b4df5c9f28f0baadde7e0f7f7d85d/ios-typography-side-by-side.svg)

Visual proof from live iPhone 17 Pro Simulator after tapping through onboarding to Gateway Details:

![iOS manual fallback typography proof](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/Solvely-Colin/bf4e26d5e9c18f1a8d452108d0ae0ba1/raw/e3f60c75c7f5d7e86b8509869b872bb3b77c2e8c/ios-typography-manual-fallback-after.svg)

Validation run locally because the installed Crabbox/Testbox client is too old for the configured Testbox provider:

- `pnpm ios:gen` passed.
- XcodeBuildMCP `build_run_sim` passed for `apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj`, scheme `OpenClaw`, simulator `iPhone 17 Pro`; app launched and screenshot was captured from the live simulator.
- XcodeBuildMCP `test_sim -- -only-testing:OpenClawTests/OpenClawTypographyTests -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation` passed: 11 tests, 0 failures.
- `swift test --filter ChatTranscriptCacheStoreTests` in `apps/shared/OpenClawKit` passed: 39 Swift Testing tests across `ChatTranscriptCacheStoreTests` and `ChatCommandOutboxStoreTests`.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.

Known noise: the Xcode build/test logs still report existing SwiftLint length/complexity warnings in unrelated iOS/shared files; they did not fail the build or focused tests.
